The tagged unit changed only in its setup call: mgr.apply/applyListeners became reconcile(..., BindLenient), the policy the deleted wrappers passed; the unit binds one free loopback port, where lenient and strict bind alike, and every assertion line is byte-identical. Where this unit carries a revert record (TestDoTListener, TestDoHListener, TestRFC7858DoTNegotiatesOnlyBCP195Suites, the two RFC 2181 4.1-1 units), it was re-observed red today. Prior judgement re-read against the current body and stands: TestRFC2181_UDPReplySourceAndPort reads the reply on the client's own ephemeral socket and matches the query id; a reply sent to any other destination port never arrives and the read fails.
